notes.title: BIG Fall Showcase 2025 + New demo update!
notes.notes: [p]Cupiclaw is taking part in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/26397247/sale/bigfallshowcase2025"]BIG Fall Showcase[/url], running from September 2–9![/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, a brand new demo update is now available, built with your feedback from the previous playtest in mind![/p][p][/p][p][b]Major changes:[/b][/p][p]• New upgrade system between floors[/p][p]• New prizes and a brand new machine[/p][p]• New key system between floors[/p][p]• New difficulty mode[/p][p]• Unlockable prizes [/p][p]• New Japanese, Chinese and Korean translations[/p][p][/p][p][b]Minor changes:[/b][/p][p]• Automatic save system[/p][p]• Confirmation screen between rounds (you can now remove prizes even after selecting them) [/p][p]• Rebalanced timer, values and costs [/p][p]• Reworked collection view[/p][p]• Reworked prize removal flow[/p][p]• Morris' hands are now visible in game (can be toggled off)[/p][p]• UI and graphics improvements[/p][p]• Enhanced visual effects[/p][p]• New Stats menu[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you all enjoy this updated version, and thanks again for your support and feedback![/p]

notes.title: Demo 0.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Cupiclaw’s 0.2.0 demo update is now available![/b]

[b]Major changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The claw now moves down until full before going up
[*] Penalties can now be removed in exchange for 5 tokens (+2 per penalty level)
[*] Reworked Nature transformation effect: transformed prizes now have the same value as the player’s prize
[*] One free reroll is given per round
[*] Rebalanced prize values to reflect these changes
[*] One new prize
[*] New BGM
[/list]

[b]Minor changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The game is now lost on the last round if not enough money is gathered (sorry for those who won this way before! 🙏)
[*] Upgrade view stops appearing if the game is over
[*] The pause menu can now be opened during the upgrade phase
[*] Settings can now be accessed in-game
[*] Remaining coins are visible in the end details
[*] Highest obtained coins are saved in the collection view (a proper stats view will be added later)
[*] The coin animation can now be accelerated with an input
[*] Slightly increased the chances of obtaining prizes of the same type
[*] The rotten apple is now categorized as Food instead of Penalty
[*] Prize quantity is indicated in the description
[*] Various visual and translation fixes
[/list]

Feel free to share your feedback on this new version!
